property_summary: For every admissible input where transfer completes, the reference contract's transfer returns true (successful completion), whereas the mutant returns false for the same inputs; the test asserts that calling transfer completes and returns true on the reference.

For all admissible inputs where msg.sender is the authorized sender and _tos.length > 0, the reference C.transfer(...) always returns true upon successful completion; the mutant returns false for at least one such admissible input, so the return value differs.

For any non-empty _tos array called by the authorized sender, C.transfer(...) returns true (completes and returns true); the mutant returns false for some admissible inputs, so asserting the call's returned boolean is true distinguishes them.

For any non-empty _tos array invoked by the authorized sender and any amounts, the reference C.transfer(...) completes (does not revert) and returns true; the mutant that returns false will cause the returned boolean to be false for some admissible inputs, so asserting the returned value is true distinguishes them.

For any non-empty _tos array invoked by the authorized sender and with caddress set to a contract that always succeeds on low-level call, C.transfer(...) completes (does not revert) and returns true; the mutant that returns false will make the returned boolean false for some such admissible inputs.
